audit.independent_solution: AE=AD-DE=10-4=6. Similarity give s AB/BC=AE/ED=6/4. Thus AB=(6/4)·5=7.5, and x-2=7.5 give s x=9.5, option C. The 10 marker explicitly measures full AD.
